status: draft: written by inspecting rendered pages; pending human review
notes: Pages are 1-based PDF page indices, not printed page numbers.
'author_stated' items must be supported by caption or body text; 'must_observe' items must be visible in the image.
'must_mark_uncertain' lists things the explanation must not state as fact; 'must_not_claim' lists concrete hallucination traps.
Extraction expectations apply to Stage 1; analysis expectations apply to Stages 2-3.
'expected_labels' overrides the JATS figure list where JATS is incomplete (scanned articles).

extraction.caption_starts_with: (A,B) XRD pattern indicating presence of ZnO peaks.
hazards: Figure 1 is on the same page directly above; the two must not be merged.

must_observe: A and B are XRD patterns: Intensity vs 2 Theta, x axis 0-90.
The strongest XRD peak in A and B is labelled (101); (100) and (002) are the neighbouring labelled peaks.
C and D are FTIR spectra: Transmittance (%) vs Wavenumber cm-1, x axis 2500 to 500.
D shows a deep minimum labelled 1000.
author_stated: A,B: XRD peaks indicate ZnO (caption).
A,C: Cassia fistula mediated; B,D: Melia azadarach mediated (caption).
C,D: FTIR indicates functional groups involved in synthesis (caption).
must_mark_uncertain: Crystallite size or phase purity cannot be read from the figure alone.
Which functional group each FTIR band corresponds to unless the body text states it.
must_not_claim: Numeric intensity values of peaks beyond reading the axis scale.
That XRD and FTIR were measured on the same sample batch, unless stated in text.

extraction.caption_starts_with: SEM images of ZnO particles showing their morphology at three different resolutions.

must_observe: Six SEM micrographs in a 2 x 3 grid.
Scale bars: A 30 µm, B 1 µm, C 200 nm, D 20 µm, E 2 µm, F 300 nm.
Red dotted circles in C and F.
author_stated: A-C Cassia fistula, D-F Melia azadarach mediated NPs (caption).
Magnifications 500x, 16,000x, 65,000x (A-C) and 800x, 8,000x, 30,000x (D-F) (caption).
Red circles indicate the NPs circumference (caption).
NPs are 'more or less spherical' and clustered (body text, page 5).
must_mark_uncertain: Individual particle size distribution: not measurable reliably from these images.
must_not_claim: Particle diameters not stated in the paper.
That the caption's 'resolutions' are instrument resolutions (they are magnifications).

hazards: Table 1 sits directly below the caption and must not be included in the figure crop.

must_observe: a: cross-sectional image with layer labels (Glass, ITO, TiO2, Cs0.25FA0.75PbI3, CsPbI3, Spiro-OMeTAD, MoOx, Al) and a 200 nm scale bar.
b, d: Current density (mA cm-2) vs Potential (V) curves.
c, e: Current density and Efficiency (%) vs Time (s), annotated 'SPO at 0.95V' and 'Light'.
b and c compare thickness ratios 0:4, 1:3, 2:2, 3:1, 4:0.
author_stated: a is a STEM-HAADF image (caption).
b, c: J-V curves by reverse scan and SPO at 0.95 V for different thickness ratios of Cs0.25FA0.75PbI3 to CsPbI3 (caption).
Best device in Table 1 is the 1:3 ratio with PCE 17.39% (Table 1, same page).
must_mark_uncertain: Exact Voc/Jsc of each curve if read only from the plot: values must come from Table 1 or be marked approximate.
must_not_claim: A PCE value not present in Table 1 or text.

extraction.caption_starts_with: LULC classification maps in Dongting Lake area in 1995, 2001, 2004 and 2013.
hazards: The lower two maps are cut off in the published PDF: their panel labels, scale bars and the bottom of their legends are not visible.
Table 2 is real text directly below the caption.

must_observe: Four classified maps with north arrows.
Upper legends list: riparian forest, paddy field, dry land, built-up land, forest land, reed beach land, marsh land, mud beach, water body.
Upper-left scale bar in km (0-80).
Lower maps are visibly truncated.
author_stated: Maps correspond to 1995, 2001, 2004 and 2013 (caption).
must_mark_uncertain: Labels of the lower two maps: the 2004/2013 assignment comes from the caption order, not from visible labels.
Area changes between years must come from the text/Figure 3, not from visual estimation of colours.
must_not_claim: Specific area values (km2) read from the maps.

extraction.panels: grid of 21 regional sub-plots without letter labels
extraction.caption_starts_with: Regional-scale changes following Black Death in four BDP pollen indicators.
hazards: Fig. 3 occupies the top half of the same page.

must_observe: Each sub-plot shows four indicators (Slow succession, Fast succession, Herding, Cereals) with point estimates and intervals on a 'Mean difference' axis.
Each region carries a sample size, e.g. Baltic: South (n = 275), Russia (n = 20).
Colour legend: grey = less than 90%, blue = CI 90%, red = CI 95%.
author_stated: Difference between means of 1250-1350 and 1351-1450 CE, with standard deviation (caption).
Significance based on bootstrap estimates (caption).
Rows ordered from significant increases to significant declines in cereal pollen (caption).
must_mark_uncertain: Demographic interpretation per region (that is the authors' inference and must be attributed).
must_not_claim: A causal mortality figure for any region derived from this plot alone.

must_observe: a: co-IP blots with IgG/Flag lanes; probed for PARP1, Flag and GAPDH input.
b: immunofluorescence in HGC-27 and MGC-803 cells: DAPI, DIDO1-529aa-Flag, PARP1, Merge.
c: PARP1 domain map (BDB, AMD, BRCT) and deletion constructs 1-1014, 1-372, 373-524, 525-1014 with blots and docking structures.
d: DAPI, DIDO1-529aa-Flag and gamma-H2AX staining in vector vs overexpression for MGC-803 and HGC-27.
e: blots for cleaved caspase3, caspase3, cleaved PARP1, PARP1, GAPDH.
author_stated: Scale bars: 25 µm in b, 50 µm in d (caption; values are not printed on the image).
DIDO1-529aa interacts with PARP1 (caption title).
must_mark_uncertain: Band intensity quantification: no densitometry shown in this figure.
Which PARP1 fragment binds, unless taken from text.
analysis.known_issue: Caption contains the typo 'PRPA1' for PARP1; explanation should not propagate it as a different protein.

extraction.panels: 2 x 3 grid without letter labels; columns 'No / Manual / Automated segmentation', rows T1-CE and FLAIR
extraction.caption_starts_with: A 53-year-old woman with a meningioma grade II in the left frontal lobe
hazards: Caption is in a narrow column to the LEFT of the image, not below it.

must_observe: Axial brain MRI slices; top row labelled T1-CE, bottom row FLAIR.
Middle and right columns show a red overlay on the lesion.
In the FLAIR row the overlay covers a larger area than in the T1-CE row.
author_stated: Manual and automated segmentation correlate very well (caption).
Dice 0.92 for TTV and 0.95 for T1CE TV for this patient (body text, page 5, cites Fig. 3).
must_mark_uncertain: Left/right orientation and lesion size in cm: not given by the image.
must_not_claim: Any diagnosis or clinical recommendation beyond what the paper states.

hazards: Figure is assembled from many image tiles: native extraction yields fragments; render the region instead.

must_observe: Ball-and-stick structure with atom labels C1-C19, N1, N2, O1-O4 and colour key C (grey), H (white), N (blue), O (red).
Dotted lines O4-H...O3 (red) and O1-H...N1 (blue).
O4 is a separate atom not covalently bonded to the molecule.
author_stated: Compound 5 crystallizes in monoclinic Cc; Figure 1 shows the asymmetric unit (text, page 4).
Empirical formula C19H24N2O4 (Table 2).
acceptable_inferences: O4 is likely a co-crystallized water molecule (formula has one O and two H more than the drawn molecule) — must be labelled as inference.
must_not_claim: Bond lengths not given in text or tables.

hazards: Vector graphics: there may be no embedded raster image for this figure.

must_observe: a: SMILES -> SMILES Encoder (GRU) -> Zs -> SMILES Decoder (GRU) -> SMILES.
b: MS/MS spectra -> Spectra Encoder (CNN) -> ZM, objective min||ZM - ZS||.
c: Spec2Mol = Spectra Encoder (CNN) + SMILES Decoder (GRU), from spectra to SMILES.
author_stated: Encoder and decoder trained separately, sharing the embedding space (caption).
Spectra encoder uses two 1-D CNN layers and two fully connected layers (text, page 10).
acceptable_inferences: The example SMILES Cn1cnc2c1c(=O)n(C)c(=O)n2C corresponds to caffeine — the paper does not name it here; must be labelled as inference.
must_not_claim: Model accuracy figures not stated near this figure.
